T-033 is still blocked: the Day 1 test email and WhatsApp can't be sent until Adi finishes T-408 (the sending domain) and T-419 (the test WhatsApp number). Everything else the Orchestrator asked for checks out in this run, and I changed no code.

1. **Push and deploy:** done, nothing new to push or deploy. Both delivery commits (3d7c62a2 and a7d83a00) are on origin/main, and both are in the build the live revops-centre Worker (version 7a94c18c) runs. No `cloud/` file changed on origin/main since that build. On a fresh local centre with the simulator, probe-day-delivery passed 27/27 and probe-output-delivery passed 20/20. Both servers I started are stopped.
2. **Idempotent per attendee and day:** done locally. Both probes passed their "no duplicate on the next tick" checks, so it isn't proven against live Tantra yet.
3. **No Twilio, n8n or SendGrid call:** done locally. Both probes passed this check.
4. **Delivery-only WhatsApp account:** done. Live `/admin/api/delivery` shows `delivery_whatsapp_account` 6acbd96d05f08b0c4b56f207, running, wired to the 3 draft Day campaigns (6acc378b, 6acc37a1, 6acc37a9). Live reminders read `whatsapp=None`. Locally, probe-day-delivery confirmed that follow-ups, lanes and nurture gain no WhatsApp step either.
5. **Adi test WhatsApp number:** none to use. A read-only query on the live database found 9 Adi test attendees, and none has a WhatsApp number. So the Day 1 WhatsApp leg waits on T-419.
6. **"Asked of Adi":** done. It reads "Waits on T-408 and T-419, nothing to answer here."
